units.summary: The company is facing margin pressure from rising wages and fuel costs and lower prices demanded by large retail customers; it wants to grow without hiring more office staff for each new customer.
units.quote: Honestly, because our margins are getting thinner every year. Wages go up, fuel goes up, and the big retail customers push prices down. Several of the big retail contracts come up for renewal in 2027. We want to grow, but we cannot keep hiring more office people for every new customer.

conflicts.description: The meeting recording says the board would be open to investing around €60,000–80,000 in AI-related projects if the first pilot shows results. The strategy document says the 2027 budget proposal earmarks EUR 50,000 for digitalisation and AI pilots, with further investment to be decided based on results. The meeting notes flag the strategy document as giving a different figure; the instructions establish no source hierarchy, so the discrepancy is unresolved.
